Wygraj dwie rundy. W każdej liczysz sumę: Win two rounds. Each round scores the combined strength of your three rows. Once both players pass, the higher score wins. A tie awards a point to both; if both reach two points, the match is a draw.
Wybierz Europe lub North America. Na poc: Choose Europe or North America. Start with 21 of 50 cards and exchange up to 3. Exchanged cards return to the deck only after replacements are drawn. The computer keeps its starting hand. The first player is random; the computer starts round two and you start round three.
Zagraj kartę do jej rzędu, wybierz cel z: Play a card into its row, choose an ability target, or pass for the rest of the round. You can keep playing after your opponent passes. An empty hand only allows passing. After the round, board cards go to their owners’ graveyards, effects clear and hands remain. There is no draw between rounds or active leader ability.
Muster przywołuje karty tej serii tylko: Muster summons cards of the same series from the deck only, never from the hand or graveyard. At least 3 Coalition or Tech cards give each card +2. The Canadian Guard gains +1 per allied horse card. The Mermaid gives her two immediate neighbours +2.
Blackout ustawia siłę kart zależnych od: Blackout sets electricity-dependent cards to strength 1. Historical cards, leaders, Bigfoot and protected cards are immune. Leaders cannot be picked up or moved. Protection and immunity block all negative effects.
Katastrofy działają w jednym wybranym rz: Disasters affect one chosen enemy row until the round ends; Strike lasts until its owner’s next action, including end-of-round scoring. Identical disasters do not stack. Tornado removes all weakest vulnerable cards; Sanctions weaken one strongest card (the leftmost in a tie).
Kolejność siły: wartość bazowa, premie,: Strength is calculated in this order: base, bonuses, Sanctions, halving the row, Blackout, Strike. Halves round down. Censorship and Data Leak disable bonuses; Crises, Flood, Katrina, Drought and Assault halve row strength. These clarify incomplete effects in the design.
Krasnal zabiera wybraną kartę z planszy: The Gnome returns a chosen board card to your hand and goes to the graveyard. The Green Elf removes all disasters and Sanctions on your side. Pact moves your non-leader card between rows. Bribe summons a random non-leader from the opponent’s graveyard without triggering its ability. Spy gives strength to the opponent and draws up to 2 cards. An empty deck produces no extra cards.
Wyłóż karty, odrzuć ostatnią: Meld your cards, discard the last one
Gramy dwiema taliami po 52 karty, bez jo: Use two 52-card decks without jokers. There are 2–4 players with 13 cards each; you start and turns proceed clockwise. Start each turn by drawing from the face-down or discard pile, then optionally meld or add cards. End by discarding one card. The first player with no cards after discarding wins.
Sekwens to co najmniej 3 kolejne karty j: A run is at least 3 consecutive cards of one suit. A set is 3 or 4 cards of one rank in different suits. Two identical cards do not form a set. An ace is always 1: A-2-3 works, Q-K-A does not. Face cards are worth 10; other cards their rank.
Select cards and use “Prepare meld”. You can prepare several melds and lay them down together for at least 51 points. Preparing does not play cards. After opening there is no point threshold and you can add cards to any meld on the table. Always keep a card for the final discard.
Po wyczerpaniu talii odrzucone karty są: When the deck runs out, discards are shuffled except for the top face-up card. If none can be shuffled, the game is a draw. The MVP limit is 100 turns per player (200 with two players); the lowest hand total then wins, or equal totals draw. This version explicitly clarifies the general source rules.
Each player starts with 1,000 virtual chips. Blinds stay at 10 / 20. The dealer rotates each hand. Heads-up, the dealer posts the small blind and acts first preflop; the big blind acts first afterwards. With 3–4 players, small blind is left of the dealer, big blind next; preflop starts after the big blind and later streets with the first active player left of the dealer. Players without chips are eliminated. Win all the chips to win the match.
Po dwóch kartach własnych następuje pref: After two private cards comes preflop, then three flop cards, one turn and one river. Each stage has betting. The best five-card hand from seven wins; you may use both, one or neither of your private cards.
Czekaj, jeśli nie masz nic do dopłaty. S: Check if nothing is owed. Call, raise or fold. The raise field is the total bet for this betting round, not an additional amount. The minimum raise equals the last full raise (initially 20); a smaller raise is allowed only at the all-in limit.
Zakład nie może przekroczyć największego: A bet cannot exceed the largest remaining opponent stack in the hand. When at most one player can still bet, the remaining board is revealed automatically. Multiple all-ins create side pots: each player can win from another only up to their own contribution. Ties split the pot; an odd chip goes to the player after the dealer. After a fold, the other player wins without showing cards.
Układy od najwyższego: poker królewski,: Hands from highest: royal flush, straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card. An ace can start A-2-3-4-5. Ties are broken by successive highest cards.
